# Motivation

Currently, the `grf` package and causal forests do not support panel ata.
However, researchers often use panel data to estimate causal effects, and 
as Athey and Imbens (2016) show, data-driven HTE estimation has much better qualities compared to testing researchers' pre-defined hypotheses.
